analyzed_vuln.description: `QueryOps::completeMolQueries()` assumes every atom query is an `ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY` and performs an unchecked `static_cast` (`atom->getQuery()` -> `ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY*`). For the PoV, the mol block (`M  RBC ...`) builds an `AtomAnd` query (`Queries::AndQuery<int, Atom const*, true>`), so the cast is invalid and UBSan reports a bad downcast at QueryOps.cpp:963. The crash is caused by type confusion from incorrect query-type assumptions in `completeMolQueries` (and recursive child casting in `completeQueryAndChildren`).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Data flows from `MolDataStreamToMol()` -> `finishMolProcessing()` -> `QueryOps::completeMolQueries()` when `_NeedsQueryScan` is set by parsed mol properties. A crafted mol block containing query-producing properties (here `M  RBC  1   1  -2`) creates a non-`ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY` root query (`AtomAnd`) on an atom. When `completeMolQueries()` iterates queried atoms, it blindly casts and dereferences as `ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY`, triggering UB/crash.
